about: The channel's own thumbnails, used as references by grok_thumbnail_generator.py. Each render sends 2 references that show the host's face (matched to the planned expression) and up to 2 that show the planned layout. Add a new thumbnail by dropping the image here and describing it below; images not listed are used as layout references only.

Giant 3D gold '3!' with red neon inlay on the left; host on the right, shocked, pointing at it with both hands; crimson background.
'$15.9 BILLION!?' in white and gold top-left, a neon-green arrow made of flying dollar bills, a gold bar in the host's hand; host on the right, shocked, pointing left.
Huge white '4' with a red glow over a faded collage (electric car, rocket, X logo, AI head), curved white arrow; host on the right, knowing smirk, pointing left; crimson.
Glowing gold '4' with HUD data lines on the left; a public figure in profile on the right holding a glowing jeweled gauntlet; dark red-purple.
Host on the left, warm smile, pointing right at a public figure lit by a spotlight from above, looking up; huge white '300' with red glow bottom-right; red-to-blue split.
A public figure on the left under a blue spotlight, looking up; host on the right against red, shocked, pointing up; no text.
'PAID TO PANIC' in huge white letters top-left on dark navy; host peeking through a large torn-paper hole edged in red glow on the right, smirking; a smaller torn hole with a figure holding cash.
